how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stormwind-city-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1264:details:0: The beginning of every month the Kul Tiras Marines all get paid and usually leave ⟦E2⟧ for somewhere else. A lot of them come here to womanize, carouse, and just have a good time. One of those groups I'd consider regulars here at the tavern, and I believe this Hendel is among them.
rows.quest:1264:details:1: BCommander Samaul in ⟦E2⟧ would be able to help you find him if Hendel's still stationed there. He's completely loyal to Proudmoore, but if you drop Elling's name, he should help you out... discreetly.
rows.quest:1264:completion:0: A pleasure to meet you, ⟦1⟧. I am Commander Samaul. I'm in charge of Miss Proudmoore's forces here in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1264:completion:1: BAlthough I'm quite busy, if you have any questions, please feel free to speak up. I might have to keep it short, but there's no reason for me to be rude if you need my help.
rows.quest:1264:completion:2: BIf you plan on traveling out of the city, I'd suggest you be careful. Besides ogres, orcs and murlocs, the southern part of the swamp is filled with black dragons.
rows.quest:1265:obj:0: Search Sentry Point for any sign of Private Hendel.
rows.quest:1265:details:0: Hendel? Yes, I know the man. But why would you need one of my soldiers?
rows.quest:1265:details:1: BElling sent you to find him? Hmm, I don't like the sound of that. Elling wouldn't have you come to me first if your business wasn't troubling. I understand if you can't tell me what this is about, but know this: I have a duty to protect these lands. If you're going to cause a disturbance, then I suggest you inform me of whatever you can.
rows.quest:1265:details:2: BI believe Hendel was stationed at the first tower outside of ⟦E2⟧. Be cautious.
rows.quest:1265:completion:0: The man you seek, the one known as Hendel, is not here. Other sources have brought to the Lady Proudmoore information I believe you already know. She has asked me to find you, and give you aid in your venture. If you would allow it, I will tell you where to find Private Hendel so we can bring him to justice.
rows.quest:1266:details:0: Private Hendel is to the west of here. He's currently on guard duty protecting some of ⟦E2⟧'s infiltrators while they rest. They've been keeping tabs on the ⟦E3⟧ base, Brackenwall, and looking for anything else that might threaten our borders.
rows.quest:1266:details:1: BYou should have no problem finding him; just look for the tents along the road.
rows.quest:1266:details:2: BI have another matter to attend to, but I shall catch up to you soon enough. You can always find me in the Lady Proudmoore's tower if you have any problems.
rows.quest:1266:completion:0: Hello, citizen. This is a dangerous place to be wandering about. I wouldn't hang around too long if you value your life.
rows.quest:1266:completion:1: BIf you keep your questions short, I'll see if I can help you. Just keep your eyes open for any of those filthy ogres. Rumor has it there's a ⟦E3⟧ base somewhere in the swamps. The infiltrators are doing what they can to find it, but the process has been slow going and we've had little progress.
rows.quest:1267:obj:0: Speak to Jaina Proudmore in Dustwallow Swamp.
rows.quest:1267:completion:0: Thank you for your help ⟦2⟧. Please accept this token of my appriciation for your efforts.
rows.quest:1274:details:0: Excuse me, ⟦3⟧. Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.
rows.quest:1274:details:1: BIf you could quietly head to ⟦E4⟧ Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. Again, please be discreet. It is a matter of some importance.
rows.quest:1274:completion:1: BNo doubt if you're asking me about my business here in the keep then young Thomas has succeeded in requisitioning you to help our kingdom. He has always been adept at following my requests.
rows.quest:1274:completion:2: BI'm afraid I don't have time to elaborate much, so allow me to be blunt... and please, try to keep this from becoming common knowledge.
rows.quest:1301:obj:0: Speak with Vincent Hyal in Menethil ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1301:details:0: Before working here at the Blue Recluse, I was trained by one of the best chefs and innkeepers I'd ever met. His name was James Hyal. Everything I have and everywhere I've gotten in life is thanks to him.
rows.quest:1301:details:1: BI wonder how he's doing. His brother Vincent and he went to work in a tavern in Menethil ⟦E5⟧, but I haven't heard from him recently.
rows.quest:1301:details:2: BIf you ever happen to be headed in that direction, maybe you could say hello to him for me?
rows.quest:1301:completion:0: James? Oh, he left quite some time ago.
rows.quest:1301:completion:1: BFelt the second wind of patriotism, I suppose. Not hard to see why he would. With all the insanity in Lordaeron, many people joined up with Jaina Proudmoore when she went across the sea.
rows.quest:1324:details:0: What?! You come here accusing me of allying with the Defias, and think I'll just stand here while you insult me?! Something tells me you've had this coming for a long time.
rows.quest:1324:completion:0: I assure you, we're all quite upset about current events, but allow us to take him back to ⟦E2⟧ for some questioning, and we'll see about finding the King.
rows.quest:1324:completion:1: BI'm sure my lady Proudmore would like to thank you for your help. Speak to her when you have a moment.
rows.quest:1363:details:0: As caretaker of the works here in the library of the Academy of ⟦E6⟧ Arts and Sciences, it is my responsibility to ensure all the magical tomes and scrolls are accounted for at all times. Who knows what folly would unfold if some of these enchanted texts were to fall into the wrong hands?
rows.quest:1363:details:1: BWhich reminds me... my assistant, Dellis, made a horrible mistake last week. He's quite able in the library but incompetent when he leaves the gates of ⟦E4⟧. Be a hero, and help old Dellis out, would you?
rows.quest:1363:completion:0: It wasn't my fault. Really it wasn't.
rows.quest:1364:obj:0: Retrieve Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence and deliver them to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.
rows.quest:1364:details:0: Master Mazen's directions were quite clear: Deliver a very important essay to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.
rows.quest:1364:details:1: BBut I had never been to the ⟦E7⟧ before! The journey was frightening!
rows.quest:1364:details:2: BWhen I got to the ⟦E8⟧, I made a wrong turn and ended up surrounded by horrible plant-like swamp creatures. They lurched as if to attack me so I ran. But in my haste I dropped the essay. One of the beasts took it I am sure.
rows.quest:1364:details:3: BCould you please try to retrieve it and deliver it to Mahar Ba?
rows.quest:1364:completion:1: BFor some time I had feared my request for Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence had been overlooked by Master Mazen of the Academy of ⟦E6⟧ Arts and Sciences.
rows.quest:1364:completion:2: BHe must be bogged down with requests considering the many strange happenings going on.
rows.quest:1364:completion:3: BNow, if you'll excuse me, I need to begin my research at once. To finally glimpse the insight of one as great as Khadgar excites me to no end.
rows.quest:1447:details:0: Yeah, you're obviously not the smartest ⟦5⟧ to come into ⟦E4⟧, but you're about to be one of the dumbest to never leave.⟦6⟧⟦7⟧Have you met me friends?
rows.quest:1447:completion:0: So, you came to me for a reason. What is it you need?
rows.quest:1448:obj:0: Brohann Caskbelly in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
rows.quest:1448:details:0: There was a time when I was young and full of vigor like you, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:1448:details:1: BBut now I'm old and unable to explore the world like I once did. Ah, the things I saw!
rows.quest:1448:details:2: BBut there was one mystery that eluded me. For my final quest, the Explorers' League sent me in search of The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It was rumored to be located in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1448:details:3: BBecause of my frail state, I traveled the skies by gryphon in search of it but never found it.
rows.quest:1448:details:4: BHelp an old dwarf out? Perhaps you will have better luck on foot.
rows.quest:1448:completion:0: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar has been sunk beneath the Pool of Tears? And surrounded by the green dragonflight?
rows.quest:1448:completion:1: BAn amazing discovery, ⟦9⟧. But obviously something has gone terribly wrong.
rows.quest:1449:obj:0: Speak with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:1449:details:0: As I mentioned earlier, I attempted to scout the temple on my own from the air. Well, I wasn't exactly alone.
rows.quest:1449:details:1: BI traveled to the renowned gryphon aviary at Aerie Peak in ⟦E9⟧. There I enlisted the aid of one of their finest pilots. The pilot fell off his mount, down into the swamp...
rows.quest:1449:details:2: BIn my old age the poor fellow's name eludes me. The master of the aviary would remember, no doubt.
rows.quest:1449:details:3: BJourney there and seek out Falstad Wildhammer.
rows.quest:1449:details:4: BWe need to find out what happened to that pilot.
rows.quest:1449:completion:0: What do you want, ⟦10⟧? Can't you see I've got problems to take care of here? Who has time to stand around yapping with some ⟦11⟧ chatterbox?⟦12⟧⟦13⟧There are trolls coming out of the woodwork! Make it snappy.
rows.quest:1477:details:0: Our mages are conducting research at Nethergarde Keep in the ⟦E7⟧, research vital to our understanding of the Dark Portals. They require nearly constant supplies, but our supply line to Nethergarde is tenuous.
rows.quest:1477:details:1: BYou must help ensure the supplies make it to Nethergard. Report to Watchmaster Sorigal in Darkshire, and do as he asks. This task will take you into hostile lands, ⟦14⟧. Prepare yourself.
rows.quest:1477:completion:0: Andromath sent you? Very good. I have an important task for you...
rows.quest:2745:details:0: Hmm, an interesting tale, and not one to be taken lightly. Yeah, I can help you, but what you need to do is divvy out a form of justice that's not... legal, if you're to see this through to the end.
rows.quest:2745:details:1: BLescovar and Marzon need to be dealt with, and swiftly. Do you think you're capable of such a thing?
rows.quest:2745:details:2: BYou decide. If so, then make haste to the castle and find an old friend of mine, a gnome named Tyrion. He's been watching Lescovar now for a couple weeks. He should be able to help you end this.
rows.quest:2745:completion:0: What the...?! Don't sneak up on me like that! And keep your voice down! What in the name of the Shadow are you doing sneakin' up on me for? Can't you see I'm busy, you daft fool?
rows.quest:2745:completion:1: BWhat do you mean, what am I doing? I'm waiting for the next Dark Portal to open, what the heck do you think I'm doing? Speak your peace and be off with you... 'fore the guards notice the two of us hiding in the bushes together. I have a reputation to maintain.
rows.quest:2746:obj:0: Bring 3 Silk Cloth and 2 of Clara's Fresh Apples to Tyrion in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2746:details:0: Trias wants the timetable pushed up some, huh? Okay, we can do that, but I'm not ready. And know this, I'm doing the hard part, but you're the one that's going to get ⟦15⟧ hands dirty, understand? Good.
rows.quest:2746:details:1: BOkay, I'll need you to get me a few things before I can put my plan into effect. I got the perfect disguise that'll get Spybot past those guards.
rows.quest:2746:details:2: BBring me some ⟦E10⟧ and a couple apples. The ⟦E10⟧'s up to you, but Clara's little farm right outside the city has the perfect sized apples.
rows.quest:2746:completion:0: These will do nicely, ⟦16⟧. Great job.
rows.quest:2746:completion:1: BI have the rest of the gear I'll need in my pack... thank the Light I just got a tailor friend of mine to make me a ⟦E10⟧ bag. I was running out of room carrying all my gear around.
rows.quest:2746:completion:2: BBefore Spybot heads in, let's get the details set so you know what you have to do.
rows.quest:3765:details:0: ⟦E4⟧ -- such a bustling hub of activity.
rows.quest:3765:details:1: BI have traveled from afar to seek help. Often it is heard that brave adventurers roam these city streets.
rows.quest:3765:details:2: BMy brother, Gershala, requires assistance in ⟦E12⟧. He resides in the seaside town of Auberdine.
rows.quest:3765:details:3: BThe journey is a long and epic one. It is for this reason that I ask the help of a seasoned ⟦17⟧ such as yourself.
rows.quest:3765:completion:0: Ah, so my brother, Argos, sent you? I realize you must be weary from your travels. But we have much to talk about.
rows.quest:3787:obj:0: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:3787:details:1: BA colleague of mine would like to speak with you about the research you are doing in conjunction with the Cenarion Circle. He is a druid by the name of Quintis Jonespyre, and he resides in Feathermoon Stronghold, ⟦E13⟧. He would like to confer with you about morrowgrain... and he very much would like for you to keep our discussion from the ears of the Arch ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:3787:details:2: BIf you're interested, speak with him; no doubt, all will be revealed once you do.
rows.quest:3787:completion:0: I thank you for coming, weary traveler! Allow me to introduce myself - I am Quintis Jonespyre, druid and humble servant of Malfurion and the Cenarion Circle. My colleagues (General Shandris Feathermoon and the Protectorate - mayhap you've heard of us) and I wanted to talk with you about the work you are doing for Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:3787:completion:1: BBefore we get much further, I'd like to ask that our discussion stay between just us. If you have no problem with this, then we may proceed.
rows.quest:3789:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E14⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:3789:details:0: Excuse me ⟦18⟧, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.
rows.quest:3789:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle in ⟦E15⟧ is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Arch ⟦E14⟧ Fandral Staghelm is spearheading this research.
rows.quest:3789:details:2: BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within ⟦E15⟧ proper.
rows.quest:3789:completion:0: Well now, ⟦19⟧... since you were informed that I was leading this research myself, you obviously came as quickly as you could.
rows.quest:3789:completion:1: BNow that you are here, be sure to pay attention the first time I tell you the details; I have no desire to repeat myself.
rows.quest:5048:obj:0: Find Ol' Emma in ⟦E4⟧ and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone. If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.
rows.quest:5048:details:0: She's a tad ornery, and quite possibly out of her gourd... but the records indicate that Ol' Emma does fit the framework of who Emma Felstone might be.
rows.quest:5048:details:1: BPerhaps you've seen Ol' Emma wander the city - she talks to herself, most often in nonsensical jibber-jabber. Still, she doesn't hurt anything or anyone, so folks pretty much leave her be.
rows.quest:5048:details:2: BAll things considered, I would say that Ol' Emma is in fact Emma Felstone. You might try asking if her last name is indeed Felstone.
rows.quest:5048:completion:0: My name is indeed Emma Felstone - you're the first person in years to call me that. Who... who are you?
rows.quest:5048:completion:1: BYou say you knew... my sister?! Is she still alive? Who am I kidding, of course she isn't. When the plague broke out in Lordaeron, I had come to expect the worst. So many of my family died... or worse. Here I am now, crazy Ol' Emma, all alone. What are you, a grave-robber or something? Looking for your next target?
rows.quest:5048:completion:2: BWhat... you have a package for me from my sister?
rows.quest:5066:obj:0: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:5066:details:0: Hear ye, hear ye! All heroes are called upon to heed these words!
rows.quest:5066:details:1: BA call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of ⟦E4⟧! All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the ⟦E17⟧! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the ⟦E18⟧!
rows.quest:5066:details:2: BHeroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the ⟦E16⟧!
rows.quest:5066:completion:0: Welcome to the ⟦E18⟧, hero. This is one of most dangerous frontiers in ⟦E19⟧, especially with the looming threat of the Scourge to our north and northeast. I am glad to hear that the clarion call of duty and service to the greater good did not fall on deaf ears with you!
rows.quest:5066:completion:1: BIf you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:6182:obj:0: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town ⟦E4⟧. He resides in the Barracks.
rows.quest:6182:details:0: ⟦E20⟧ Marris was the first and last of the human ranger lords. A disciple of Sylvanas Windrunner, now the Banshee Queen of the ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:6182:details:1: BWe had thought that ⟦E20⟧ had been killed in action in the defense of Lordaeron five years ago. Although his corpse was never recovered, it was assumed that he did not make it out of the ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:6182:details:2: BMathias Shaw has been investigating the disappearance and may have some new information. Report to him at once. He resides in Old Town, at the Barracks.
rows.quest:6182:completion:0: After some reports of unusual ⟦E21⟧ activity in the ⟦E22⟧, SI:7 agents were dispatched to investigate. The results of that investigation are unsettling.
rows.quest:6183:obj:0: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.
rows.quest:6183:details:0: Five of my best field agents were assigned the Marris case. One returned, only to end up dead in his sleep three days later.
rows.quest:6183:details:1: BWhat little information we did manage to get out of him was incoherent gibberish. We made out two words: "⟦E20⟧", and "Blightcaller."
rows.quest:6183:details:2: BI do not have the available manpower to continue this investigation and Ravenholdt will not assist us. We must get to the bottom of this; if only to provide closure to the families of the deceased. Will you help?
rows.quest:6183:completion:1: BI had faith that Bolvar would send me men and women of honor - the most dedicated soldiers of the ⟦E23⟧.
rows.quest:6186:obj:0: Return to ⟦E4⟧ and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of ⟦E20⟧ Marris.
rows.quest:6186:details:0: <The blood appears to have completely drained from Flint's face.>
rows.quest:6186:details:1: BNa... ⟦E20⟧ did this? ⟦E20⟧ is the Blightcaller?
rows.quest:6186:details:2: BWhy? He was... was so noble - a ranger lord respected by all. The only human ever allowed to train under the high elves. Now a ruthless agent of the ⟦E21⟧?
rows.quest:6186:details:3: BI... I am sorry to ask this of you, ⟦21⟧, but Highlord Fordragon must be informed of this turn of events at once. Please, return to ⟦E4⟧ and deliver the news.
rows.quest:6186:completion:0: No. It... NO! How? An agent of the ⟦E21⟧? The CHAMPION of the Banshee Queen???
rows.quest:6186:completion:1: B<Highlord Bolvar Fordragon slumps in defeat.>
rows.quest:6402:obj:0: ⟦E11⟧ to ⟦E24⟧ and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.
rows.quest:6402:details:0: You are to meet with Windsor at the gates of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6402:details:1: BWhat Windsor is about to unveil will shake the very foundation of the kingdom!
rows.quest:6402:details:2: BDo not attempt to venture there alone, ⟦22⟧. You must amass an army! Gather your compatriots. To arms!
rows.quest:6402:completion:0: Before we begin, I ask that you first gather an army. We face a dragon, after all!
rows.quest:6403:obj:0: Follow Reginald Windsor through ⟦E4⟧. Protect him from harm!
rows.quest:6403:details:0: It has been quite the adventure, friend. I owe you a great debt of gratitude. Perhaps, when all is said and done...
rows.quest:6403:details:1: BAs you have no doubt ascertained by now, Lady Prestor is ⟦E25⟧: Brood of ⟦E26⟧, twin to the tyrant of the Spire, ⟦E27⟧.
rows.quest:6403:details:2: BFor too long she has held our kingdom in her captivating gaze. Even the Highlord is controlled by her trickery - a puppet. It all ends today... The spell will be broken.
rows.quest:6403:details:3: BWorry not, for together, we shall be victorious!
rows.quest:6403:completion:1: BThe magic held within must be reignited. The dragon's eye must be attuned.
rows.quest:6403:completion:2: BWindsor's sacrifice has freed our Kingdom, but the threat of ⟦E25⟧ and her kin is ever looming.
rows.quest:6403:completion:3: BThis medallion is what held my mind and body captive. It is also what gave me access to ⟦E25⟧'s own mind - to her secrets. Albeit the visions are muddled now, some things I do remember.
rows.quest:6501:obj:0: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.
rows.quest:6501:details:0: A fragment of the shattered medallion is all that I can offer.
rows.quest:6501:details:1: BYou must find another of dragon blood willing to assist you in forging a new key. Once you secure this key, you must travel to the Wyrmbog in ⟦E1⟧. It is there that you will find her lair, ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:6501:details:2: BWhere to find other flights willing to help? Sadly, I do not know... They are said to exist. Some may even work and live among us, disguised as one of the humanoid races. I wish you luck.⟦24⟧
rows.quest:6501:completion:0: I should have known - a piece of the black dragon brood mother, ⟦E25⟧. How revolting...
rows.quest:7495:obj:0: Take the Head of ⟦E25⟧ to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:7495:details:0: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to the Highlord.
rows.quest:7495:completion:0: For so many years I was held under her captivating gaze. Finally, to see justice meted and the honor of ⟦E4⟧ restored! Today, we celebrate this glorious victory!
rows.quest:7496:obj:0: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.
rows.quest:7496:details:0: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes, ⟦25⟧. He will be expecting you...
rows.quest:7496:completion:0: Few are graced with such ceremony, ⟦26⟧. Please, choose your reward so that we may begin the celebration.
rows.quest:7497:completion:0: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled.
rows.quest:7497:completion:1: BPlease accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.
rows.quest:7497:completion:2: BCreate the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... ⟦E27⟧.
rows.quest:7781:obj:0: Return the Head of ⟦E27⟧ to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:7781:details:0: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of ⟦E27⟧. Return it to your Highlord, champion.
rows.quest:7781:completion:0: You need not be told the meaning of what you have done, ⟦27⟧. This day will be recorded in the annals of history. A victory the likes of which has not been known to the ⟦E23⟧ for years - if ever!
rows.quest:7782:obj:0: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in ⟦E24⟧ and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
rows.quest:7782:details:0: Go to the Valley of Heroes and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
rows.quest:7782:completion:1: BChoose your reward, let the celebration begin!
rows.quest:7791:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦29⟧!
rows.quest:7793:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦30⟧!
rows.quest:7794:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦31⟧!
rows.quest:7795:completion:0: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.
